cases.question: What is the maximum speed limit for vehicles transporting explosives on rough roads and elsewhere?
cases.answer:  The speed of the vehicle shall not exceed 25 km/h on rough roads and 40 km/h elsewhere. [Page 110]

cases.question: What minimum clearance must an excavator maintain from any fixed object while performing a swinging motion?
cases.answer:  Excavators shall maintain a clearance of at least 0.6 m (2 ft) from any fixed object while performing a swinging motion. [Page 137]

cases.question: What are the maximum allowable mesh opening dimensions and length for safety nets?
cases.answer: Mesh openings must not exceed 36 square inches, and must not be longer than 6 inches on any side. [Page 77]

cases.question: What is the maximum distance allowed for a means of exit from any worker inside a trench?
cases.answer: • Have a means of exit provided from the inside of the trench, usually no more than 8m (25 ft) away than any worker in the trench. [Page 103]

cases.question: According to IS 4379, what are the ground colour and band colour for Carbon dioxide and Nitrogen gas cylinders?
cases.answer:
*   Carbon dioxide cylinders have a ground colour of Black and a colour band of White or Aluminium paint [Page 153].
*   Nitrogen cylinders have a ground colour of French grey and a colour band of Black [Page 153].

cases.question: In the risk assessment matrix, what is the description and control level for a relative risk rating between 21 and 25?
cases.answer: 21-25 — Risk requires an immediate attention; action must be documented and completion time limit may be decided. — Very high [Page 29]

cases.question: What are the first aid procedures for handling an amputated body part?
cases.answer:
 Don't panic, stay calm and call for help [Page 185]
 Call ambulance help line number like 102 in India or any other medical helpline number [Page 185]
 Apply direct pressure on the wound to control bleeding [Page 185]
 Cover wound with sterile gauge piece or clean cloth and apply pressure bandage [Page 185]
 Place the amputated part in a clean plastic bag [Page 185]
 Place the plastic bag containing amputated part in another container with ice and mark with date and time of packaging with victim details [Page 185]
 Get to the hospital immediately with victim and amputated part [Page 185]
 Do not put any antiseptics or liquids or home remedies on the amputated area and part [Page 185]
 Ice shall not be come in direct contact with the amputated part [Page 185]
 If not sure don't do anything, just call for help and assist to get in hospital at earliest [Page 185]

cases.question: Explain the Roll-Pull-Hold-Check technique for wearing earplugs.
cases.answer: * The correct method for using an earplug involves the Roll-Pull-Hold-Check Technique [Page 173].

cases.question: What are the voltage protection levels and differences between Class A, Class B, and Class C hard hats?
cases.answer:
*   Class A hard hats provide limited voltage protection up to 2200 volts [Page 166].
*   Class B hard hats offer the highest level of protection against electrical hazards, including high-voltage shock and burn protection up to 20000 volts, as well as protection from impact and penetration hazards [Page 166].
*   Class C hard hats provide impact protection but offer no protection from electrical hazards [Page 166].

cases.question: Under Rule 210 of the DBOCW Rules, what must the authority do if an accident causes the death of five or more persons?
cases.answer: * A notice given under sub-section (1) relating to an accident causing death of five or more persons requires the authority to whom the notice is sent to make an inquiry into the occurrence within one month of the receipt of the notice [Page 203].

cases.question: What is the priority order of the hierarchy of risk control measures?
cases.answer:
I. Elimination [Page 31]
II. Substitution [Page 31]
III. Engineering control [Page 31]
IV. Administrative controls [Page 31]
V. Personal Protective Equipment [Page 31]

cases.question: What is the recommended minimum duration for construction workers' safety and health training?
cases.answer: The training should be appropriate to the work and the duration shall be so decided that it gives the worker enough time to acquire necessary skill and knowledge, to enable him/her to perform his work safely, preferably not less 48 hours. [Page 45]
